fixture.mutation: ALTER DELETE WHERE max_time < toDateTime64(cutoff,3,UTC), mutations_sync=2

protocol: Two same-host unmodified RAW_UUID TimeSeries v11 tables; both ingest same 48000 old and2000 live IDs and physically DROP only August old SAMPLES partition, with source/body SHA equality. One keeps original 50000 TAGS and50000 TimeRanges, the other keeps same50000 TAGS and deletes 48000 old TimeRanges. No extra sidecar/index and no C++ build. Both active SAMPLES parts exact same bytes. Stop merges during queries. For broad1d and project=p0, paired A0(full),B1(pruned),B2(pruned),A3(full) with 3 warmup+10 timed native full-label/timestamp/numeric-oracle requests per phase, QueryFinish cpu/read_rows/bytes/marks/query peak, control drift gate25%. Then reinsert one old ID with fresh sample and verify TimeRanges restoration and native group. 104 full native queries.
cost_bound: Removing 48000/50000 TimeRanges rows cuts native SQL read_rows from 102000 to54000 (-47.06%), matching 50000 TAGS+2000 TR+2000 SAMPLES. Read_bytes cut ~24.3%, but wall p50 improved only ~2%, and exact project p50 regressed ~3.5%. Broad query CPU effect ~4.82% below preregistered 5% practical minimum despite 0.54% drift. This gives an empirical Amdahl-style bound for this workload: metadata IO reduction alone does not dominate full native time. Garbage collection mutation CPU/writes are not yet counted, so net economics likely less favorable.
limitations: One hosted runner; minor 2-5% effects should not be promoted without independent repetition and cleanup-write-cost accounting.
Direct TimeRanges mutation is isolated but unsafe to run in production without TTL completion proof, concurrent-writer isolation, and multi-replica coordination.
Only broad/p0 finite gauge 1d selectors, not 14d high-cardinality regex/negative matchers or histograms/NaN.
Another agent owns R07 time-day sidecar. Do not duplicate its active-ID access path or treat read row count as latency.

next_action.step: Do not promote TimeRanges-only direct cleanup as a performance optimization. Focus on the larger remaining 50000 TAGS scan via read-only time-aware access path only with R07 owner coordination. If considering retention-based physical GC, first design atomic cache and replica invalidation plus late-arrival/resurrection tests, and measure mutation CPU/storage lifecycle.
next_action.stop_condition: No global TimeRanges deletion or TAGS GC in production; negative narrow-result and limited broad result remain part of scientific record.
